title: 第2章 第一案：518儿童被拐案（2）
slug: 崽崽捡破烂变捡尸警局追着颁奖
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

石母：!!!∑(ﾟДﾟノ)ノ

李安国：Σ(゜ロ゜;)

任曼妮：(✧ω✧)

“老婆！老婆！”石父赶紧接住石母软倒的身子，将她抱进怀里，“李警官，我求你！一定要赶紧救回我儿子！”

石父哭得泣不成声。

石嘉熙是老来子，他和石母平常含在嘴里怕化了，捧在手里怕摔了。

去哪都脚打脚跟着。

发现孩子不见的时候，两人天都塌了！

李安国安慰：“放心，我们一定会找回孩子！”

滴嘟滴嘟滴嘟——

警车出发。

念念暂时被交给任曼妮照看。

任曼妮询问了一些基本信息。

包括但不限于念念的家庭住址，还有监护人，以及监护人的工作。

念念叹气。

“阿姨，我刚刚不是说过了吗？我和爷爷一起生活，爷爷是收破烂的。”

任曼妮尴尬笑笑，“那你爷爷平常会说什么奇怪的话吗？比如让你和他一起去街上乞讨，或者收养很多小孩子？”

念念：(｡•ˇ‸ˇ•｡)

“阿姨，你是在怀疑我爷爷吗？”

任曼妮：(;ﾟДﾟi|!)

这小孩也太聪明了吧！

任曼妮连忙否认，“不是不是，我怎么会怀疑你爷爷呢，我就是例行询问。

我们警方办案，都是这样的。”

念念眼神狐疑，小手往旁边一指，理直气壮到：“那你为什么不问他们爷爷？”

任曼妮：……

石家夫妻今年都五十岁了。

爷爷早驾鹤西去了，就算还活着，那年纪少说也得过百。

一个年纪过百的老人，走路都颤颤巍巍，还能拉着年仅五岁的孙儿上街乞讨？

画面太美，她不敢想！

任曼妮擦擦额头冒出的汗。

审问念念这活，还真不是她一个实习警员能干的！

原以为小孩子性格单纯，好忽悠，问什么说什么。

谁知道念念竟这么精明。

Stone Mother:!!!∑(ﾟДﾟノ)ノ

Li Anguo: Σ(゜ロ゜;)

Ren Manni: (✧ω✧)

"Wife! Wife!" Father Shi quickly caught Mother Shi's limp body and held her in his arms. "Officer Li, I beg you! You must save my son as soon as possible!"

Father Shi burst into tears.

Shi Jiaxi is an old man. He and Shi Mu usually hold it in their mouths for fear of melting, and hold it in their hands for fear of falling.

Wear heels wherever you go.

When they found out that the child was missing, both of them were devastated!

Li Anguo comforted: "Don't worry, we will definitely find the child!"

Didu, didu, didu——

The police car sets off.

Niannian was temporarily handed over to Ren Manni's care.

Ren Manni asked for some basic information.

Including but not limited to Nian Nian’s home address, guardian, and guardian’s job.

Nian Nian sighed.

"Auntie, didn't I just say that? I live with my grandfather, and my grandfather collects rags."

Ren Manni smiled awkwardly, "Then does your grandfather usually say anything strange? For example, asking you to go begging on the street with him, or adopt many children?"

Niannian: (｡•ˇ‸ˇ•｡)

"Auntie, are you doubting my grandfather?"

Ren Manni: (;ﾟДﾟi|!)

This kid is too smart!

Ren Manni quickly denied, "No, no, how could I doubt your grandfather? I was just asking routinely.

This is how our police handle cases."

Nian Nian's eyes were suspicious, and she pointed to the side with her little hand, confidently saying: "Then why don't you ask their grandpa?"

Ren Manni:......

The Shi family couple are both fifty years old this year.

Grandpa left Hexi a long time ago. Even if he is still alive, he would be over a hundred years old at least.

An old man who is over a hundred years old and walks tremblingly can still drag his five-year-old grandson to beg on the street?

The picture was so beautiful that she didn’t dare think about it!

Ren Manni wiped the sweat from her forehead.

The job of interrogating Nian Nian is really not something she, a trainee police officer, can do!

I thought that children were simple and easy to fool, and they would say whatever they asked.

Who knew Niannian could be so smart.
